classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: Light steady prep (1); continuous batch smashing and flipping (2); burger plus one stirred sauce (1); smash-sear technique, timing-sensitive (1); one skillet (0). Sum 5 -> moderate; floor rule 1 (continuous attention + any other >= 1) also requires at least moderate. WAVE proposed easy; batch searing over a hot pan is not easy under the rubric. Complexity: 11 countable (1). All mainstream supermarket items (0). One stirred sauce; patties take salt and pepper only (0). Sum 1 -> simple.
